title: Medical Assistance Eligibility Start and the Patient Pay Month Paid from Resident Funds
content:
When a Resident Trust Fund Accounts account pays Medicaid patient pay under a standing authorization, the transfer is for the latest service month on the resident's case under Medical Assistance Nursing Facility Coverage, and the named month's patient pay follows **the month's standing on the case**. The standing follows the eligibility start date:

| Case record | Standing of the named month | Named month's patient pay |
|---|---|---|
| the case is eligible and its eligibility start date falls after the last day of the named month | the approval left that month out | nothing, because estimates billed for months before the eligibility start date are reduced in full |
| the case is eligible and its eligibility start date falls on or before the last day of the named month | the month is eligible, because the month in which eligibility starts is billed at the notice's patient pay | the month's patient pay amount |
| otherwise (for instance, the case is still pending or was denied) | the month keeps the charge as billed | the charge as billed |

## Both sides of the boundary (hypothetical dates, named month April)

| Case | Eligibility start | Named month's patient pay |
|---|---|---|
| eligible | 1 May | nothing |
| eligible | 1 April | the month's patient pay amount |
| eligible | 1 January | the month's patient pay amount |
| pending | none yet | the April charge as billed |
